components.title: Synapse
components.text:
If your Army Faction is TYRANIDS, while a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly SYNAPSE models, that TYRANIDS unit is said to be within Synapse Range of that model and of your army. While a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within Synapse Range of your army:
- Each time that unit takes a Battle-shock test, take that test on 3D6 instead of 2D6.
- Each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

components.title: Shadow in the Warp
components.text: If your Army Faction is TYRANIDS, once per battle, in either player’s Command phase, if one or more units from your army with this ability are on the battlefield, you can unleash the Shadow in the Warp. When you do, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test. Each time an enemy unit takes such a Battle-shock test, if it is within 6" of one or more SYNAPSE units from your army, subtract 1 from that test.

rule.title: Surprise Assault
rule.text:
Each time a TYRANIDS model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
Each time a BURROWER unit from your army is set up on the battlefield from Reserves, place a circular 40mm Tunnel Marker anywhere on the battlefield within 1" of that unit and more than 3" horizontally away from all enemy units.
In the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, when you set up a unit on the battlefield from Reserves, you can set that unit up wholly within 9" of one of your Tunnel Markers and more than 6" horizontally away from any enemy units.
If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 3" of one of your Tunnel Markers, that Tunnel Marker is removed from the battlefield.
KEYWORDS
MAWLOC and TRYGON units from your army have the BURROWER keyword.
In the Muster Armies step, you can select up to 2 TRYGON models from your army. The selected units gain the CHARACTER keyword.
Designer’s Note: This means that the selected models can be given Enhancements and one of them can be selected as your WARLORD.

enhancements.title: Synaptic Strategy
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Once per battle, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

enhancements.title: Tremor Senses
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three friendly TYRANIDS units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.title: Vanguard Intellect
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

enhancements.title: Trygon Prime
enhancements.text: TRYGON model only. The bearer gains the SYNAPSE keyword. Improve the Strength and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

stratagems.title: ADAPTIVE OPTIMISATION
stratagems.flavor: On occasions where subterranean assaults are deemed tactically useful, the hive mind may spontaneously alter its burrowing organisms, enabling them to act as beacons for its will.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One MAWLOC or TRYGON unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the SYNAPSE keyword.

stratagems.title: REPLENISHING SWARMS
stratagems.flavor: Scrambling through the tunnels come endless multitudes of warrior-beasts and harvester bioforms, spilling out of the depths to reinforce the teeming masses.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army, wholly within 9" of one or more Tunnel Markers you placed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: One model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or you can return up to D3+1 destroyed models with a Wounds characteristic of 1 to your unit, with their full wounds remaining, instead.

stratagems.title: ENFILADING EMERGENCE
stratagems.flavor: Emerging from the depths, Tyranid bioforms level their weapon morphs and spit hissing volleys of living ammunition into the exposed backs of outflanked prey.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

stratagems.title: TUNNEL NETWORK
stratagems.flavor: Taking advantage of freshly burrowed tunnels, Tyranid bioforms move swiftly across the landscape, emerging in unexpected locations.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more of your Tunnel Markers and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Remove your unit from the battlefield and set it up again, wholly within 9" of another Tunnel Marker you placed, and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.title: SWARMING ASSAULT
stratagems.flavor: A hive fleet’s vanguard organisms favour mobility and aggression, keeping the foe on the back foot with repeated coordinated assaults.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of your unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

stratagems.title: RETREAT BELOW
stratagems.flavor: The network of tunnels beneath the battlefield enables Tyranid organisms to retreat from the foe and prepare further ambushes.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit or up to two BURROWER units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rule.title: Hyper-adaptations
rule.text:
At the start of the first battle round, select one of the following Hyper-adaptations to be active for TYRANIDS units from your army until the end of the battle:
Swarming InstinctsEach time a TYRANIDS model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets an INFANTRY or SWARM unit, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.Hyper-aggressionEach time a TYRANIDS model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.Hive PredatorsEach time a TYRANIDS model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, on a Critical Hit, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

rows: Swarming InstinctsEach time a TYRANIDS model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets an INFANTRY or SWARM unit, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
Hyper-aggressionEach time a TYRANIDS model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
Hive PredatorsEach time a TYRANIDS model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, on a Critical Hit, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.title: Alien Cunning
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three TYRANIDS units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.title: Perfectly Adapted
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll, one Damage roll, one Advance roll, one Charge roll or one saving throw made for the bearer.

enhancements.title: Synaptic Linchpin
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. While a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 9" of the bearer, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.

enhancements.title: Adaptive Biology
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. At the start of any turn, if the bearer has fewer than its starting number of wounds remaining, until the end of the battle, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

stratagems.title: RAPID REGENERATION
stratagems.flavor: Prey stare in horror as chitinous armour regrows and flesh, muscle and sinew knots back together.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.

stratagems.title: ADRENAL SURGE
stratagems.flavor: These warrior organisms destroy all as their adrenaline surges.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army and are eligible to fight, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army that is eligible to fight.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in any of those selected units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.title: DEATH FRENZY
stratagems.flavor: Tyranids care nothing for self-preservation, lashing out even in death.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.title: OVERRUN
stratagems.flavor: Tyranids in battle form an unstoppable avalanche of flesh and chitin that buries the foe alive.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just before a TYRANIDS unit from your army Consolidates.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That TYRANIDS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, instead of making that Consolidation move, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.title: PREDATORY IMPERATIVE
stratagems.flavor: Guided by the instincts of leader-beasts, the swarm can be tasked with focusing its hunting instincts.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one Hyper-adaptation. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hyper-adaptation is active for those selected units in addition to any other that may be active for your army.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You cannot select the same Hyper-adaptation you selected at the start of the first battle round.

stratagems.title: ENDLESS SWARM
stratagems.flavor: As the battle rages, more organisms pour in to bolster the swarms.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: Up to two ENDLESS MULTITUDE units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: You can return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each of the selected units.

rule.title: Synaptic Imperatives
rule.text:
At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Synaptic Imperatives shown below. Until the end of the battle round, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your army and while a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within Synapse Range of your army, it will benefit from it. Each Synaptic Imperative can only be selected once per battle.
- Synaptic Augmentation: While this unit is within Synapse Range of your army, models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
- Surging Vitality: While this unit is within Synapse Range of your army, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.
- Goaded to Slaughter: While this unit is within Synapse Range of your army, each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.title: Power of the Hive Mind
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS PSYKER model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of psychic weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.title: Psychostatic Disruption
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS SYNAPSE model only. Enemy units that arrive on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer. In addition, once per battle, during the first or second battle round, when your opponent declares that a unit will arrive on the battlefield from Strategic Reserves, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit cannot arrive on the battlefield this turn.

enhancements.title: Synaptic Control
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS SYNAPSE model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.title: The Dirgeheart of Kharis (Aura)
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS SYNAPSE model only. While an enemy unit is within 9" of the bearer, worsen that units Leadership characteristic by 1.

stratagems.title: THE SMOTHERING SHADOW
stratagems.flavor: In the heart of the swarms, the Shadow in the Warp can literally kill with its smothering power.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One SYNAPSE unit from your army within 12" of that enemy unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.title: SYNAPTIC CHANNELLING
stratagems.flavor: Tyranids are one with the Hive Mind; individuality is a disadvantage that they surpass.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One SYNAPSE unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, while a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 9" of the selected unit, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.

stratagems.title: IRRESISTIBLE WILL
stratagems.flavor: Whether paralysing its prey or forcing them to stumble out of cover with its force of will, or else puppeteering nearby warrior organisms, the leader-beast ensures the prey targets are struck down.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the attacking model’s unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.title: REINFORCED HIVE NODE
stratagems.flavor: Psionic shielding crackles around these leader-beasts, helping to ensure their survival.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One SYNAPSE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.title: IMPERATIVE DOMINANCE
stratagems.flavor: At need, the focused will of the Tyranid leader-beasts can goad warrior organisms to exhibit strategically beneficial behaviours at the instant they are needed most.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one Synaptic Imperative, even if you have already selected that imperative this battle. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your unit instead of any other Synaptic Imperative that is active for your army.

stratagems.title: OVERRIDE INSTINCTS
stratagems.flavor: The seemingly omniscient Hive Mind processes the sensory input of its swarms at an impossible rate, and compels its broods to react accordingly.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and made a Fall Back move this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn.

rule.title: Feed the Swarm
rule.text:
In your Command phase, each HARVESTER unit from your army can Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit that is within 6" of it. A unit can only be regenerated once per phase. Each time a unit regenerates, do one of the following:
- One model in that unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.
- One destroyed INFANTRY model (excluding CHARACTERS) is returned to that unit with its full wounds remaining. If that unit is an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit, up to 3 destroyed models are returned instead.

enhancements.title: Regenerating Monstrosity
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only (excluding MONSTERS models). The bearer’s unit can be regenerated up to twice per phase, instead of once.

enhancements.title: Instinctive Defence
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly HARVESTER units, when you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP. In addition, while the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly HARVESTER units, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.title: Biophagic Flow (Aura)
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. While a friendly HARVESTER model is within 12" of the bearer, when using the Feed the Swarm ability, that HARVESTER model can Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit that is within 9" of it, instead of one within 6".

enhancements.title: Parasitic Biomorphology
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit. The first time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase while the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly HARVESTER units, until the end of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit.

stratagems.title: BROODGUARD IMPULSE
stratagems.flavor: Should a foe successfully slay one of the swarm’s assimilation organisms, they only mark themselves as a priority for predation and consumption in turn.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: RECLAIM BIOMASS
stratagems.flavor: Dead Tyranids are consumed and reconstituted by the swarm just as readily as the lifeless carcasses of their prey.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed, before the last model in it is removed from play.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within 6" of that destroyed unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (See Feed the Swarm).

stratagems.title: TYRANNOFORMED
stratagems.flavor: Swarms of diminutive Tyranid phage organisms carpet even the most vital strategic assets, steadily breaking them down for assimilation.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HARVESTER unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

stratagems.title: ABLATIVE CARAPACE
stratagems.flavor: These organisms have employed consumed minerals to exude an additional hardened protective layer over their chitinous armour.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HARVESTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, until the end of the phase models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

stratagems.title: SECURE BIOMASS
stratagems.flavor: When rich sources of biomass are identified the warrior organisms of this swarm will stop at nothing to destroy resistance and claim them.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a HARVESTER unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit as well.

stratagems.title: RAPACIOUS HUNGER
stratagems.flavor: The hunger of the Tyranids can never be satiated.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that just destroyed an enemy unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit immediately Regenerates (See Feed the Swarm). When doing so, if your unit is a HARVESTER unit and you choose for one model to regain up to D3 lost wounds, that model regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.

rule.title: Enraged Behemoths
rule.text: Each time a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that model’s unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that model’s unit is Below Half-strength. In addition, while a TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army (excluding Battle-shocked units) is at its Starting Strength, add 2 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.title: Ominous Presence
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER model only. Add 3 to the bearer’s Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.title: Enraged Reserves
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER model only. If the bearer is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 3+, do not remove it from play. It can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.title: Null Nodules
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER model only. Once per battle, when a Psychic Attack is allocated to the bearer, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

enhancements.title: Monstrous Nemesis
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: CORROSIVE VISCERA
stratagems.flavor: Highly acidic fluids spray from the creature’s wounds, lethal to those nearby.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that cannot FLY is destroyed.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

stratagems.title: RAMPAGING MONSTROSITIES
stratagems.flavor: Tyranid monsters have reserves of energy that they unleash in waves of devastating fury.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.title: SAVAGE ROAR
stratagems.flavor: This monster is even more terrifying to behold than other bioforms of its kind.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that Battle-shock test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.title: UNTRAMMELLED FEROCITY
stratagems.flavor: Encircling and entrapping such physically powerful and fearless beasts is nigh on impossible.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so: - It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them. - It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after its unit has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, your unit is Battle-shocked.

stratagems.title: SWARM-GUIDED SALVOES
stratagems.flavor: One cannot hide from a gestalt entity with a million eyes, even in the densest cover.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

stratagems.title: MASSIVE IMPACT
stratagems.flavor: Employing their sheer bulk and vicious chitinous horns and spikes, the largest Tyranids crash headlong through the foe, often with devastating results.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase, just after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army ends a Charge move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your model and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rule.title: Questing Tendrils
rule.text: TYRANIDS units with this ability are eligible to charge in a turn in which they Fell Back. VANGUARD INVADER units with this ability are eligible to charge in a turn in which they Advanced.

enhancements.title: Hunting Grounds
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your opponent sets up a Reserves unit on the battlefield, roll one D6: on a 2+, that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.title: Chameleonic
enhancements.text: VANGUARD INVADER model only. This unit has Stealth.

enhancements.title: Stalker
enhancements.text: VANGUARD INVADER model only. At the start of the battle, select one enemy unit. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.title: Neuronode
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to three VANGUARD INVADER units from your army and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.title: SURPRISE ASSAULT
stratagems.flavor: Vanguard organisms strike from unexpected quarters with calculated and emotionless alien savagery that is appalling to behold.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That VANGUARD INVADER unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit that was selected as the target of one or more of your unit’s attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the Battle-shock test was failed, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.title: ASSASSIN BEASTS
stratagems.flavor: These bioforms have been adapted to strike with pinpoint precision at the pre-assessed weak points of selected prey that require elimination.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One VANGUARD INVADER INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.title: SEEDED BROODS
stratagems.flavor: Warrior organisms erupt from concealment straight into advanced positions.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves, or up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are in Reserves.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up those selected units on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

stratagems.title: HYPERSENSORY SCILLIA
stratagems.flavor: Hissing clusters of scillia warn of the slightest prey movements, allowing the Tyranids to react.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit, or one other TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Those selected units can each make a Normal move of up to 6".

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You cannot target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.title: UNSEEN LURKERS
stratagems.flavor: Hyper-attuned senses warn vanguard organisms when they are being targeted by the prey.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One VANGUARD INVADER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18" or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6". Your opponent can select new targets for the attacking unit’s attacks.

stratagems.title: INVISIBLE HUNTER
stratagems.flavor: Hunter-slayer organisms can melt away before the eyes of their foes, only to strike from a new direction.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: Up to two VANGUARD INVADER units from your army, or one TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Remove the targeted units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: The targeted units must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.

rule.title: Insurmountable Odds
rule.text: In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model from a friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit was destroyed as a result of those attacks, that friendly unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

enhancements.title: Relentless Hunger
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.title: Naturalised Camouflage
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. At the start of the first battle round, select up to three friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE units within 9" of the bearer. Until the end of the battle round, each time a ranged attack targets one of those units, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.title: Piercing Talons
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.title: Adrenalised Onslaught
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Each time the bearer’s unit Piles In or Consolidates, models in this unit can move an additional 3".

stratagems.title: SYNAPTIC GOADING
stratagems.flavor: For a moment, a minuscule sliver of the Hive Mind’s ineffable will is focussed through these warrior organisms, driving them to pounce upon either valuable prey or else some vital strategic target.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase, just before an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a surge move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: When making that surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker (instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit]. All other rules for making surge moves still apply.

stratagems.title: UNENDING WAVES
stratagems.flavor: No matter how many warrior organisms are slain, more are already surging forward over their corpses.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: Any destroyed CHARACTER units that were attached to your unit are not returned. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.title: TEEMING MASSES
stratagems.flavor: Skittering, darting and pouring over one another, the Tyranids make for hard and confusing targets.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.title: SWARMING MASSES
stratagems.flavor: The sheer weight of Tyranid numbers begins to tell as they bury their victims in lashing, biting horror.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and If your unit contains 15 or more models, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.title: BOUNDING ADVANCE
stratagems.flavor: Synaptic impulses from the Hive Mind urge greater speed from the swarm’s warrior organisms.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.title: PRESERVATION IMPERATIVE
stratagems.flavor: Triggered by incoming projectile fire, a synaptic pulse spurs the danger-senses of lesser warrior organisms and causes them to scatter like a shoal evading predators. Only once the explosions have stopped and the dust cleared do the bioforms bunch up once again.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, your unit is treated as containing fewer than five models for the purpose of the [BLAST] ability.

rule.title: Mindhunger
rule.text:
- Friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR units have Deep Strike.
- Friendly LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR units’ attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

enhancements.title: Encircling Horrors
enhancements.text: NEUROLICTOR/LICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit only. In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.title: Cryptophotaic Camouflage
enhancements.text: VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

stratagems.title: COUNTERPREDATION
stratagems.flavor: One should never attempt to lay a trap for perfectly adapted ambush hunters, lest one become the prey in turn.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, when a friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit is selected to fight.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 S and AP.

stratagems.title: HYPERSENSORY ADAPTATIONS
stratagems.flavor: The organisms that comprise the Tyranid vanguard possess exceptionally keen senses, detecting prey no matter how well hidden it may be and relaying its location to the wider Hive Mind.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

stratagems.title: SCANNER GHEIST
stratagems.flavor: What seemed a certain and identified Tyranid contact vanishes suddenly from sight and sensors both, seemingly nothing but a ghost all along.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly unengaged DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/ NEUROLICTOR unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

rule.title: Higher Imperatives
rule.text:
Friendly NORN EMISSARY/NORN ASSIMILATOR units have the following ability:
Protean Purpose: (Once per battle, per unit) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit can make a selection for its Singular Purpose ability (this replaces the previous selection).

enhancements.title: Destabilising Predation
enhancements.text: NORN EMISSARY unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [ANTI-CHARACTER 2+].

enhancements.title: Synaptoprescience
enhancements.text: NORN ASSIMILATOR unit only. This unit has 4+ InSv.

stratagems.title: CATALYTIC BIOFORTIFICATION
stratagems.category: Talons of the Norn Queen Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Impacts and surface damage trigger explosive inflammation within this organism’s exoskeleton, spawning hardened outer layers that stave off even the most grievous hurts.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit suffers a mortal wound.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That NORN ASSIMILATOR unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.title: LESSER PREY
stratagems.category: Talons of the Norn Queen Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Focused on achieving its assigned imperative, this towering bioform smashes prey from its path with glad‑driven surges of additional might.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR/NORN EMISSARY unit is selected to fight.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That NORN ASSIMILATOR/NORN EMISSARY unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s melee attacks have +2 S.

stratagems.title: TANGLESTRIKE ROUNDS
stratagems.category: Talons of the Norn Queen Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: These revolting living shells burst on impact to ensnare nearby prey organisms in a mess of dripping, incredibly sticky strands that take time to tear free of.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit has shot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That NORN ASSIMILATOR unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is tethered until the start of your next Command phase: - While a unit is tethered, that unit has -2" M.

rule.title: Leader-beasts
rule.text:
- Friendly TYRANID WARRIORS WITH RANGED BIO-WEAPONS/TYRANID WARRIORS WITH MELEE BIO-WEAPONS units have:
- TYRANID WARRIORS.
- BATTLELINE.
- TYRANID WARRIORS/TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP/WINGED TYRANID PRIME models from your army have 5+ InSv.

enhancements.title: Elevated Might
enhancements.text: WINGED TYRANID PRIME/TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP model only. This model’s melee attacks:

enhancements.title: Ocular Adaptation
enhancements.text: WINGED TYRANID PRIME/TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP model only. This unit’s melee attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.title: ALIEN PHYSIOLOGY
stratagems.flavor: The sheer resilience of these warrior organisms appears nighsupernatural to their horrified prey.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That TYRANID WARRIORS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.title: SYNAPTIC MICRONODES
stratagems.flavor: Shed like spores from chitinous exoskeletons, these micronodes infest the very battlefield with minute motes of the Hive Mind’s consciousness.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.title: PARASITIC PAYLOAD
stratagems.flavor: The projectiles fired by this weapon are infected with parasites that burrow into the central nervous systems of their targets, causing them to shriek and convulse, giving away their position to the oncoming swarms.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TYRANID WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That TYRANID WARRIORS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORE COVER].

errata.title: Synapse Army Rule
errata.text:
Change to: ‘If your Army Faction is TYRANIDS, while a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly SYNAPSE models, that TYRANIDS unit is said to be within Synapse Range of that model and of your army. While a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within Synapse Range of your army:
- Each time that unit takes a Battle-shock test, take that test on 3D6 instead of 2D6.
- Each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.’

errata.title: Shadow in the Warp Army Rule
errata.text: Change to: ‘If your Army Faction is TYRANIDS, once per battle, in either player’s Command phase, if one or more units from your army with this ability are on the battlefield, you can unleash the Shadow in the Warp. When you do, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test. Each time an enemy unit takes such a Battle-shock test, if it is within 6" of one or more SYNAPSE units from your army, subtract 1 from that test.’

errata.title: Enraged Behemoths Detachment Rule
errata.text:
Change to:
‘Each time a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that model’s unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that model’s unit is Below Half-strength. In addition, while a TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army (excluding Battle-shocked units) is at its Starting Strength, add 2 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.’

errata.title: Untrammelled Ferocity Stratagem, Effect Section
errata.text:
Change to:
‘Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:
- It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.
- It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after its unit has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, your unit is Battle-shocked.’

errata.title: Insurmountable Odds Detachment Rule
errata.text:
Change to:
'In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model from a friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit was destroyed as a result of those attacks, that friendly unit can make a surge move of up to D6”.'

errata.title: Feed the Swarm Detachment Rule
errata.text:
Change to:
‘In your Command phase, each HARVESTER unit from your army can Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit that is within 6" of it. A unit can only be regenerated once per phase. Each time a unit regenerates, do one of the following:
- One model in that unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.
- One destroyed INFANTRY model (excluding CHARACTERS) is returned to that unit with its full wounds remaining. If that unit is an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit, up to 3 destroyed models are returned instead.’

errata.title: Instinctive Defence Enhancement
errata.text:
Change to:
‘TYRANIDS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly HARVESTER units, when you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP. In addition, while the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly HARVESTER units, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.’

errata.title: Vanguard Onslaught Detachment, Chameleonic Enhancement
errata.text:
Change to:
‘VANGUARD INVADER model only. This unit has Stealth.'

errata.title: Neuronode Enhancement
errata.text:
Change to:
‘TYRANIDS model only. After both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to three VANGUARD INVADER units from your army and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.’

errata.title: Hypersensory Scillia Stratagem, Target Section
errata.text: Change 9" to 8".

errata.title: Reinforced Hive Node Stratagem, Effect Section
errata.text:
Change to:
'Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.’

errata.title: While using the Subterranean Assault Detachment, does a Mawloc’s Terror from the Deep ability trigger when arriving via a Tunnel Marker?
errata.text: No.

errata.title: What is the effect of the Unseen Lurkers Stratagem with respect to the Balance Dataslate ruling on Stratagems that prevent units from being targeted?
errata.text:
The effect of the Unseen Lurkers Stratagem becomes:
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18" or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6". Your opponent can select new targets for the attacking unit’s attacks.

errata.title: Do units that are repositioned by rules that do not specify that the unit being repositioned is first placed into Reserves (e.g. the Grey Knights Teleport Assault rule) need to take a Battle-shock test on a roll of 2+ if a TYRANIDS CHARACTER with the Hunting Grounds Enhancement is on the battlefield?
errata.text:
Yes. Rules that are triggered by or apply to Reserves units are also
triggered by and apply to a repositioned unit when it is set back up.

errata.title: Can I use the Rapid Regeneration Stratagem when an ability like Doombolt would inflict mortal wounds on a TYRANIDS unit from my army?
errata.text: No.

errata.title: When resolving a Mawloc’s Terror From the Deep ability, which units need to take a Battle-shock test: every unit within 12" of the Mawloc, or only those units for which a 5+ was rolled when resolving that ability?
errata.text: Only those units for which a 5+ was rolled.

errata.title: If my opponent uses a rule to place a unit into Strategic Reserves during the first battle round, and that rule states that the unit must arrive on the battlefield in the next battle round, what happens if a model from my army uses the Psychostatic Disruption Enhancement in the second battle round when that enemy Strategic Reserves unit is due to arrive?
errata.text: The ‘cannot arrive’ rule takes precedence over the rule stating that the unit ‘must arrive’ from Strategic Reserves. Roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit cannot arrive on the battlefield this turn.

errata.title: If I select a unit of Neurogaunts for a Neurotyrant’s Neuroloids ability that is not led by a SYNAPSE unit, does that unit of Neurogaunts gain the SYNAPSE keyword?
errata.text: No.

errata.title: When using the Reclaim Biomass Stratagem, can the Stratagem effect be used on the unit that was just destroyed?
errata.text: No.

errata.title: Does an Attached unit containing a HIVE TYRANT and TYRANT GUARD receive the Stealth ability from a VENOMTHROPE’s Foul Spore's ability?
errata.text: No. The unit has the MONSTER keyword and the ability excludes MONSTERS.

errata.title: Are SPORE MINES units that are added to an army during a battle restricted by abilities that prevent Reserves from being set up within a certain range (e.g. Space Marines Infiltrators’ Omniscrambers)?
errata.text: No.

errata.title: Do rules such as the Insurmountable Odds Detachment rule and the CARNIFEXES’ Blistering Assault ability let me choose between not moving the unit in question or moving the unit as far as possible following the conditions?
errata.text: Yes.

errata.title: If I roll one D6 for a CARNIFEXES unit’s Blistering Assault move and then choose not to move the models, do they still count as having made a Blistering Assault move that phase?
errata.text: Yes, they have made a Blistering Assault move of 0".

errata.title: When a CARNIFEX model makes a Blistering Assault move or an ENDLESS MULTITUDE model makes a Surge move, does that model have to move the full amount allowed by the dice result?
errata.text: No, it can move any distance up to that allowed distance.

errata.title: Does a unit affected by the Psychostatic Disruption Enhancement have to arrive from Reserves in the next Movement phase?
errata.text: No.

errata.title: Does the Synaptic Goading Stratagem allow a unit to leave Engagement Range and move towards the closest objective marker?
errata.text: Yes.

errata.title: Can units targeted by the Shadow in the Warp army rule use the Insane Bravery Stratagem?
errata.text: No. Insane Bravery can only be used in your Command phase.
